subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should OpenClaw add owner/human handoff for DM auto-reply, and should the first supported scope be WhatsApp-only or a shared channel contract for WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord?
rationale: The request adds new channel config plus delivery-suppression state, so the permanent scope, resume semantics, and storage ownership need maintainer product intent before a safe implementation.

options.title: WhatsApp plugin-owned first
options.body: Implement handoff in the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with live WhatsApp proof and a future path to generalize if users need the same contract elsewhere.

options.title: Shared channel contract
options.body: Design a common channel handoff API and implement WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord together, accepting the larger compatibility and review surface.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep prompt/manual-pause workarounds until stronger live evidence or maintainer sponsorship justifies new config and pause-state surface.

recommendation.title: WhatsApp plugin-owned first
recommendation.body: Implement handoff in the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with live WhatsApp proof and a future path to generalize if users need the same contract elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent WhatsApp config/runtime history and broad channel-boundary work make steipete the best available decision owner from the observed history.
